name: io.github.jayaraju-gorle/clinic-appointments
title: Clinic Appointment Assistant
description: Search clinics, check doctor fees and timings, and request appointments 24/7.

tools.name: search_clinics
tools.description: Search configured clinics by name, city, area, or specialty to get their clinic ID, short code, address, and booking URL.

query.description: Optional search text (e.g. clinic name, locality, city, or dental/pediatrics).

tools.name: get_clinic_details
tools.description: Retrieve full clinic details including doctors, specialties, consultation fees, opening hours, address, Google Maps link, and FAQs.

clinic_id.description: Clinic UUID or short code (e.g. HANVI or AURA).

tools.name: book_clinic_appointment
tools.description: Submit a patient appointment request directly to the clinic's staff portal. Always confirm patient name, phone number, and preferred time within clinic hours before calling.

clinic_id.description: Clinic UUID or short code (e.g. HANVI).

phone.description: Patient phone number with country code.

preferred_time.description: Requested day and time (e.g. Tomorrow 5:00 PM).

source.description: AI assistant platform name (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok).
